metaData.title: Moebius Project Page
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Moebius is a 0.22B-parameter image inpainting framework that achieves 10B-level quality with over 15× inference speedup, using a novel Local-λ Mix Interaction block and adaptive multi-granularity distillation.
metaData.summary: Moebius is a lightweight image inpainting framework from HUST and VIVO AI Lab, compressing a 10B-level diffusion model into 0.22B parameters (less than 2% of FLUX.1-Fill-Dev) while matching or surpassing its generation quality across six benchmarks including natural scenes (Places2) and portraits (CelebA-HQ, FFHQ). The key innovation is the Local-λ Mix Interaction (LλMI) block, which reformulates self- and cross-attention by condensing spatial and semantic contexts into fixed-size matrices, bypassing quadratic complexity. This is paired with an adaptive multi-granularity distillation strategy operating entirely in latent space to align the compact student with the high-capacity teacher (PixelHacker). Moebius achieves 26 ms per step inference, a total of 15× acceleration, and sets a new efficiency standard for real-world inpainting. The project page includes extensive visual comparisons and accepts user uploads for testing.

mainPoints.explanation: Through synergistic architecture-distillation optimization, Moebius rivals FLUX.1-Fill-Dev and SD3.5 Large-Inpainting across 6 benchmarks, despite using less than 2% of the parameters.

mainPoints.point: 15× inference speedup enables real-time or edge deployment.
mainPoints.explanation: With 26 ms per step on a single GPU, Moebius delivers a total runtime acceleration of over 15× compared to 10B-level models, making high-quality inpainting accessible on consumer hardware.

mainPoints.point: LλMI block eliminates quadratic attention overhead.
mainPoints.explanation: The Local-λ Mix Interaction block condenses spatial context and global semantic priors into fixed-size linear matrices, bypassing the quadratic complexity of standard self-/cross-attention.

mainPoints.point: Adaptive multi-granularity distillation bridges the capacity gap.
mainPoints.explanation: Operating strictly in latent space, the distillation aligns intermediate features, semantic priors, and diffusion trajectories with a gradient-norm adaptive loss weighting, enabling a lightweight student to absorb high-capacity teacher knowledge.

keyQuotes: It shatters the heavy-compute narrative, making high-quality inpainting accessible on consumer-grade and edge devices.
Moebius achieves this using less than 2% of the parameters (0.22B vs. 11.9B) while delivering a >15× acceleration in total inference time.
Rather than blindly scaling up, Moebius answers a fundamental question: Can a model be smarter, lighter, and faster when the task is explicitly defined?

relatedArticles.title: Software Architecture Guide
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This page from Martin Fowler presents his perspective on software architecture, defining it as the important stuff in system design, and serves as a curated guide to his site's extensive resources on application and enterprise architecture.

relatedArticles.title: Dario Amodei — Policy on the AI Exponential
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Dario Amodei argues that AI is advancing exponentially, creating a dangerous mismatch with slow-moving policy, and proposes concrete actions across regulation, economics, science, civil liberties, and geopolitics to meet the moment.

relatedArticles.title: Building Generative Image & Video models at Scale - Sander Dieleman (Veo and Nano Banana)
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This is a comprehensive technical talk by Google DeepMind's Sander Dieleman, detailing the end-to-end process of training large-scale diffusion models for image and video generation, covering data curation, latent representations, core diffusion mechanisms, network architectures, scaling, sampling with guidance, distillation, and control signals.

relatedArticles.title: Falcon Perception
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Falcon Perception is a 0.6B early-fusion Transformer that unifies vision and language in a single backbone for open-vocabulary grounding and segmentation, outperforming SAM 3 on complex compositional prompts.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaomi MiMo， Explore and Love
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi MiMo and TileRT achieve 1000+ tokens/s inference on a 1-trillion-parameter model using commodity GPUs through extreme model-system codesign, including FP4 quantization and DFlash speculative decoding.

relatedArticles.title: Andrej Karpathy on the Future of Human-AI Communication: From Text to Interactive Neural Videos
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Andrej Karpathy shares a practical tip to ask LLMs for HTML output and presents a vision for the evolution of AI output from text to interactive neural videos, arguing that vision is the preferred output modality for humans.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.0 with Thinking-Level Intelligence
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0, a state-of-the-art image model featuring sharper editing, richer layouts, and reasoning capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI engineers detail a five-month experiment building a production software product with zero manually-written code, using Codex agents to achieve 10x velocity and redefining the engineer's role as system designer and feedback loop architect.

relatedArticles.title: Inside FAISS: Billion-Scale Similarity Search
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides a deep, visual, and intuitive explanation of FAISS, covering the core ideas of IVF, Product Quantization, their combination in IVFPQ, and GPU acceleration, to enable billion-scale similarity search.

relatedArticles.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Enhanced Embodied Reasoning
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6, a significant upgrade to its embodied reasoning model that enhances spatial understanding, multi-view reasoning, and introduces new capabilities like instrument reading for real-world robotics applications.
